import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os
import re

# Configure environment to suppress tqdm warnings if any
import logging

logging.getLogger("scipy").setLevel(logging.WARNING)

# Load data correctly
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Sample submission columns: {sample_submission.columns.tolist()}")


def preprocess_text(text):
    """Clean and normalize comment text"""
    if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""
    text = str(text).strip()
    # Handle escaped characters properly - convert \\n to newline-like separation then space
    text = text.replace("\n", " ").replace("\\n", " ")
    # Remove surrounding quotes if they exist (common in social data)
    text = text.strip('"')
    # Normalize whitespace
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
    # Filter out empty strings
    if not text or text.isspace():
        return ""
    return text.lower().strip()


# Apply consistent preprocessing
train_df["Comment_clean"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(preprocess_text)
test_df["Comment_clean"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(preprocess_text)

# Fill any remaining NaN values
train_df["Comment_clean"] = train_df["Comment_clean"].fillna("")
test_df["Comment_clean"] = test_df["Comment_clean"].fillna("")

# Count non-empty texts to verify preprocessing
non_empty_train = train_df["Comment_clean"].str.len() > 0
non_empty_test = test_df["Comment_clean"].str.len() > 0
print(
    f"Non-empty comments in train: {non_empty_train.sum()}, in test: {non_empty_test.sum()}"
)

# Enhanced feature extraction with improved parameters
# KEY FIX: Removed 'max_ngram' which caused TypeError. Using ngram_range=(1,3) instead.
model = Pipeline(
    [
        (
            "tfidf",
            TfidfVectorizer(
                max_features=10000,  # Reduced from 50k to speed up training slightly
                ngram_range=(1, 3),  # Explicitly defines min and max n-grams
                stop_words="english",
                min_df=1,  # Keep rare terms but filter noise
                analyzer="char_wb",
                lowercase=True,
                strip_accents="unicode",
                encoding="utf-8",
            ),
        ),
        (
            "clf",
            GradientBoostingClassifier(
                n_estimators=300,  # Reduced from 500 for speed
                max_depth=4,
                learning_rate=0.05,
                subsample=0.8,
                random_state=42,
                min_samples_split=10,
                min_samples_leaf=4,
                loss="deviance",
                verbose=0,
            ),
        ),
    ]
)

# Hold-out validation split - stratified to avoid class imbalance effects
X_train_raw, X_val_raw, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_df["Comment_clean"],
    train_df["Insult"].astype(int),
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_df["Insult"].astype(int),
)

print(f"Training samples: {len(X_train_raw)}, Validation samples: {len(X_val_raw)}")
print(f"Validation class distribution: {dict(y_val.value_counts())}")

# Fit only on training data
model.fit(X_train_raw, y_train.astype(float))

# Validate on held-out set (never fit on this data)
y_val_prob = model.predict_proba(X_val_raw)[..., 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_val_prob)
print(f"\nHold-out Validation AUC: {val_auc:.4f}")

# Generate predictions on external unlabeled test set
y_test_pred = model.predict_proba(test_df["Comment_clean"])[:, 1]

# Verify predictions are in correct range [0,1]
assert (y_test_pred >= 0).all() and (
    y_test_pred <= 1
).all(), "Predictions out of range!"
print(f"Predictions range: [{y_test_pred.min():.4f}, {y_test_pred.max():.4f}]")

# Get required column order from sample submission
required_columns = list(sample_submission.columns)

# Create submission DataFrame with proper structure
submission_df = test_df.copy()

# Add predicted Insult probability
for col in required_columns:
    if col == "Insult":
        # Put prediction here
        submission_df[col] = y_test_pred
    else:
        # Copy existing test data for these columns
        if col in submission_df.columns:
            pass
        else:
            # Fallback to test df
            submission_df[col] = test_df[col].values

# Ensure correct order
submission_df = submission_df[required_columns]

output_path = "./submission/submission.csv"
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

submission_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

print(f"\n✓ Submission saved to: {output_path}")
print(f"✓ Total submissions: {len(submission_df)}")
print(f"✓ First row predictions: {submission_df.iloc[0]['Insult']}")
print(f"\n=== FINAL EVALUATION METRIC ===")
print(f"AUC-ROC Score (Hold-Out): {val_auc:.4f}")
